Omega Advisors Inc increased its stake in Citigroup Inc (C) by 426.08% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund held 683,900 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $46.16 million, up from 130,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Omega Advisors Inc who had been investing in Citigroup Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $178.98 billion market cap company.
